info.title: cantrip - tools for the Cantrip DSL
info.description: The cantrip command-line tool: validate, lint, test and describe Cantrip content, and try statements in a REPL.

options.name: --suppress
options.description:
comma-separated diagnostic codes to leave out, e.g. CT306,CT310, or CT301
for verbs your game registers in C#. Errors from loading always show

options.name: --warnings-as-errors
options.description: lint only: exit with 1 when there are warnings, as for errors

options.name: --filter
options.description: only run tests whose name contains <text>

options.name: --trace
options.description:
print the causality trace, with any log output, for failing tests
exit codes: 0 success, 1 content errors or failing tests (or lint warnings, with
--warnings-as-errors), 2 bad usage
